1. REMOVE BOOT AND PUSH ROD
(a) Pull out the boot with the push rod.
(b) Remove the boot from the push rod.
2. REMOVE PISTON AND SPRING
Using compressed air, remove the piston with the spring from
the cylinder.
NOTICE:
